pr.title: fix(audit): run PAL audit runner as a package module
pr.body:
## Summary
- Runs the trusted PAL clink audit runner in package mode so `scripts.*` imports resolve in the workflow checkout.
- Adds a focused regression assertion for the workflow invocation.

## Scope
No credentials, branch protection, PR mutation, or PR Steward behavior changes. Existing fail-closed enforcement remains unchanged.

## Validation
Focused audit workflow test, module help invocation, task-packet validation, and diff hygiene.

## NOT_RUN
Credentialed external-auditor execution remains outside this repair and requires a separate live receipt.
